     3 | import re

     5 | _DEF = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:async\s+)?def\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)")
     6 | _CLASS = re.compile(r"^\s*class\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)")
     7 | 
     8 | 
     9 | def symbols(source: str):
    10 |     """Return (kind, name, line) triples. Comment lines are skipped."""
    11 |     rows = []
    12 |     for line_no, line in enumerate(source.splitlines(), 1):
    13 |         if line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
    14 |             continue
    15 |         found = _DEF.match(line)
    16 |         if found:
    17 |             rows.append(("def", found.group(1), line_no))
    18 |             continue
    19 |         found = _CLASS.match(line)
    20 |         if found:
    21 |             rows.append(("class", found.group(1), line_no))
    22 |     return rows
